update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.31 - Support card selection optimizations
Improvements --- - Scroll-list picker OCR runs once per row (bbox dedupe keys instead of double OCR) - Borrow slot matching respects preferred-card priority order (first list entry wins) - Borrow scroll fallback scans the list once for all preferred names - Friend-slot satisfaction uses the same priority-order matcher
Includes v5.9.30 cold start fix and prior parent-farming updates.
